title: Director, Product Growth
description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions-along with payments, material ordering, and more-into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

Roofr is looking for a Director, Product Growth to own how we grow through the product. You’ll work at the intersection of product, data, and go-to-market: designing the activation and expansion paths that keep contractors engaged, surfacing product signals that unlock sales conversations, and building a stronger self-serve experience anchored in friction-less SMB UI/UX. You’ll report to the CPO, sit on the product leadership team, and lead a cross-functional Growth team that includes Engineering, Design, Data Science, and a Principal PM as your direct report.

Initial building blocks are already in place. We have a clear activation metric that guides both our self-serve and sales-assist motion, a hybrid model that is actively evolving, and an AI product line in AI Receptionist that is ready to scale. The job is to take what’s working, sharpen it, and build on top of it.

What You’ll be measured on

• Software adoption across the subscriber base

• Orchestration of the hybrid motion

• Self-serve revenue growth, shared with the GM of Measurements

What You’ll get to do

• Orchestrate the hybrid motion with Sales: Identify the product signals that indicate a contractor is ready for a sales conversation and build the playbooks that turn those signals into pipeline, across both new subscriber acquisition and expansion of the existing base

• Drive activation and expansion: Own the in-product experience that gets new contractors to value fast and design the expansion loops that drive deeper adoption and multi-product retention across the customer base

• Grow self-serve revenue: Own the self-serve motion across transactional and subscription products, with particular focus on Measure+ and in-product upgrade paths

• Lead the team and the metrics: Lead the Growth team, including Engineering, Design, and Data Science, build a fast experimentation culture, and own the growth metrics that matter to leadership

What You’ll bring to the role

• 8 to 12+ years of product growth experience in B2B SaaS; vertical SaaS is a strong plus

• Real experience building a hybrid product-led and sales-led motion. You have felt the friction of making these work together, not just read about it

• Strong activation and expansion instincts. You know how to design user journeys that drive measurable improvement in time-to-value and long-term retention

• Experience working across both transactional and subscription revenue models

• Comfortable running experiments end to end: designing them, setting success criteria, and shipping without waiting for perfect conditions

• Fluent in growth metrics like activation rate, adoption, expansion revenue, and NRR. You run your own analysis

• Experience with tools like Amplitude, HubSpot, and Snowflake or a comparable data warehouse

• Experience building or scaling an AI-powered product is a meaningful differentiator

title: Advisory Marketing Leader (Netherlands)
description:
Job Description: Fractional Marketing Leader (Demand Generation & Enterprise Pipeline)
Company : Flosum
Role Type : Fractional / Part-Time Contract (Short-Term Stint)
Location : Remote
Reports To : CEO
About Flosum
Flosum is a rapidly growing B2B SaaS organization. In a high-growth environment, our Go-To-Market (GTM) revenue engine is our most critical asset. We are building a tightly aligned, high-performance engine, and we need a tactical marketing leader to step in and own the growth framework.
Role Overview
We are not looking for a theoretical, high-level consultant who only delegates. We are looking for a Fractional Marketing Leader who is a true "Doer." Your primary mission is simple: You will completely own the enterprise pipeline. You will shield the CEO from daily marketing operational noise, step in to actively manage and lead our current marketing team, and build a predictable, scalable enterprise demand-generation engine.
Key Responsibilities

• Pipeline Ownership: Take full accountability for the creation, tracking, and velocity of the enterprise-grade sales pipeline (MQL to SQL to Pipeline Value).

• Team Management: Act as the direct leader for the internal marketing team, establishing KPIs, clearing roadblocks, and managing day-to-day execution.

• Enterprise Demand Gen Strategy: Design, execute, and optimize multi-channel demand generation campaigns tailored specifically for high-ACV (Annual Contract Value) enterprise accounts.

• Sales & Marketing Alignment: Partner closely with Sales and leadership to optimize the GTM engine, refine our Account-Based Marketing (ABM) playbooks, and support strategic selling initiatives.

• Reporting: Deliver clear, fluff-free metrics directly to executive leadership focusing heavily on pipeline ROI, customer acquisition cost (CAC), and conversion rates.

Requirements

• Proven B2B SaaS Scaling Experience: You must have a track record of serving as an early marketing leader or key growth driver at a rapidly scaling B2B SaaS company, staying long enough to see the compounding impact of your strategies.

• Expertise in Enterprise Pipeline Generation: You must possess verifiable experience building pipeline for enterprise-level buyers ($100k+ ACV). You know how to penetrate deep into complex buying committees.

• The "Doer" DNA: You are highly tactical. While you understand the big picture, you are ready to roll up your sleeves, write copy, build campaigns, look at the data, and execute directly. Command of the Modern GTM Stack: Deep, hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM integration (Salesforce), ABM orchestration platforms, and intent data tools.

description:
Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $105,000-$143,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate high-performance, highly reliable inference platforms for serving large machine learning models in production. The role focuses on the systems engineering side of AI deployment, including request routing, batching, caching, autoscaling, GPU utilization, and end-to-end observability across diverse model workloads. The ideal candidate brings strong distributed systems and performance engineering expertise, has shipped serving systems at scale, and understands the trade-offs between latency, throughput, cost, and quality in ML serving.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

• Six or more years of experience in distributed systems, infrastructure, or ML platform engineering.

• Strong proficiency in Python and a systems language such as Go, Rust, or C++.

• Deep experience operating high-throughput, low-latency services in production.

• Hands-on experience with LLM or large model inference frameworks such as vLLM or TensorRT-LLM.

• Strong understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and accelerator utilization.

• Familiarity with Kubernetes, autoscaling, and modern cloud platforms.

• Experience with observability stacks including metrics, tracing, and structured logging.

• Solid grounding in performance engineering and capacity planning.

• Strong communication and incident response skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Open-source contributions to model serving infrastructure.

• Experience with multi-region or globally distributed AI serving.

• Familiarity with model quantization, distillation, and compression techniques.

• Exposure to FinOps for AI workloads and cost-efficient serving design.

• Experience supporting external-facing AI APIs at scale.

description:
About Neura:

Neura Health is a nationwide, doctor-led practice built to eliminate the barriers between patients and life-changing care. As the country's leading virtual neurology clinic, we provide an all-in-one longitudinal platform where cutting-edge technology meets specialized expertise to manage the entire spectrum of neurological diseases. While traditional brick-and-mortar clinics are at a breaking point, forcing patients to endure dangerous 4-6 month wait times, Neura is scaling the nation’s largest virtual practice to deliver immediate access to the 145 million Americans in need. Through strategic partnerships with leading health systems, pharmaceutical innovators, and large clinics, as well as a direct-to-patient model, we are fundamentally transforming the referral landscape and reducing average wait time from 276 days to 5 days.

Our tech-enabled model provides a comprehensive, end-to-end experience that goes far beyond a standard consultation. We offer patients seamless access to personalized care plans and expert care navigation, ensuring no one has to manage their journey alone. This mission is powered by our multidisciplinary specialized care teams, which include world-class physicians, nurse practitioners, physician associates, and dedicated care coaches. We leverage AI-powered workflow optimization and continuous monitoring for everything from chronic headaches and epilepsy to complex memory disorders. Backed by $22M in funding from world-class investors, we are not just improving neurology; we are revolutionizing it. We are looking for purpose-driven innovators to join us in making high-quality brain health a reality for everyone.

About the Role
Neura Health is expanding its care model into behavioral health, and we’re looking for our first Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) to help us build this vertical from the ground up. Given the high prevalence of co-morbid psychiatric conditions among our neurology patient population - including anxiety, depression, OCD, and PTSD alongside diagnoses like migraine, epilepsy, and memory disorders - this role is both clinically vital and strategically critical.
As the first PMHNP, you will provide high-quality telehealth psychiatric care to Neura patients, working within our multidisciplinary care team. This is a part-time contract role (minimum 8 hours per week) with significant growth potential as we scale our behavioral health vertical. Multi-state licensure is strongly preferred - the more states you are licensed in, the greater your impact.
Responsibilities

• Conduct comprehensive telehealth psychiatric evaluations, diagnoses, and treatment planning for Neura’s neurology patient population

• Prescribe and manage psychiatric medications, monitoring for efficacy and side effects in the context of neurological co-morbidities

• Collaborate closely with Neura’s neurologists, nurse practitioners, and care coaches to deliver integrated, whole-patient care

• Document all clinical encounters in the EMR accurately and in a timely manner, adhering to Neura’s documentation standards

• Participate in care team case reviews, clinical huddles, and ongoing quality improvement initiatives

• Maintain multi-state licensure and practice within your licensed states; actively pursue additional state licensure as the patient panel grows

• Dedicate a minimum of 8 clinical hours per week to Neura, with the expectation to scale hours as the behavioral health vertical expands

• Help shape and inform Neura’s behavioral health clinical protocols, workflows, and patient experience as our first PMHNP hire

• Stay current with evidence-based practices in psychiatry, telepsychiatry, and the intersection of neurology and behavioral health

Requirements

• Current, unrestricted PMHNP licensure in at least New York state; multi-state licensure strongly preferred (the more states, the better)

• Board certification as a PMHNP-BC (or ARNP with psychiatric specialty)

• Active

About us    

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving. 

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us-we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter.  We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.  

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  

The role

We are looking for a Research Scientist to join the Multi-Embodiment Generalist Agent (MEGA) team within Wayve Science as a founding member.

MEGA is building foundation models for general-purpose robots: models that learn from large-scale video, language, and robot-interaction data, then generalize across tasks and embodiments-including mobile manipulators, dual-arm platforms, and humanoids. Our aim is to build agents that can perceive, reason about, and act reliably in the physical world.

You will help define and build the foundation-model learning stack for robotics: novel model architectures, pre-training objectives, post-training methods, and scalable data and training systems. The work combines frontier ML research with a direct route to real-world evaluation on a growing fleet of robots.

Your work may span vision-language-action models, world and action models, video and multimodal models, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and self-supervised learning. You will work with large-scale video and robotics datasets and distributed training infrastructure to develop increasingly capable, robust, and general robot policies.

You will collaborate with research scientists, ML engineers, roboticists, and hardware teams to turn promising ideas into large-scale experiments, strong research contributions, and compelling robot demonstrations. This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a new ML-first research program at the frontier of foundation models and embodied intelligence.

Key responsibilities

• Research and develop model architectures, learning objectives, and data strategies for robot foundation models.

• Empirical research experience - experience hill climbing on ML models.

• Experience with various data sources - annotation, filtering, mixing strategies.

• Develop scalable self-supervised and generative pre-training methods using web video, egocentric video, and robot-interaction data.

• Develop post-training approaches-including supervised fine-tuning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and related methods-to improve real-world robot capabilities.

• Curate, filter, and evaluate large-scale robotics datasets, including egocentric, UMI, and teleoperated data.

• Build and use distributed training pipelines for large models and large multimodal datasets.

• Work closely with robotics and hardware teams to connect model progress to measurable real-world performance.

• Communicate research clearly internally and, where appropriate, through publications and Wayve’s scientific presence.

About you

In order to set you up for success as a Research Scientist at Wayve, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.

Essential

• Experience in machine learning, with focus in multimodal foundation models and data for foundation models.

• Experience with scalable training, such as multi-node training, large datasets and/or large mod

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Senior Accountant to join our team.

Position Description

The Senior Accountant will be a key member of Oklo's accounting team, with primary responsibility for preparing and posting journal entries and completing timely, accurate account reconciliations as part of the monthly and quarterly close process. • Assist with accounting research and special projects, including documenting conclusions and proposed accounting treatment

• Perform other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field

• Three to five years of progressive general accounting experience, including hands-on month-end close responsibilities

• Demonstrated experience preparing and posting journal entries and completing balance sheet account reconciliations

• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and proficiency with Microsoft Excel

Bonus Qualifications:

• Big 4 Preferred, CPA is a plus

• Master’s degree in accountancy

• Fast growth startup or public company experience

• Hands-on experience using NetSuite for general ledger accounting and financial reporting

• Hands-on experience using FloQast for account reconciliations and close management

• Experience reconciling and recording Stock Based Compensation & Payroll

Competencies

We are looking for someone that is:

• Close ownership - takes responsibility for assigned tasks and consistently meets monthly and quarterly close deadlines

• Attention to detail - prepares accurate journal entries and reconciliations supported by clear, complete documentation

• Analytical thinking - understands account activity, identifies unusual items, and explains period-over-period changes

• Problem solving - researches and resolves reconciling items and accounting issues in a timely manner

• Organization - manages multiple accounts, schedules, and deadlines in a fast-paced close environment

title: Structural Integrity Engineer
description:
Intertek , Multinational Company leader in ATIC (Assurance, Testing, Inspection, Certification) is seeking an experienced Structural Integrity Engineers for upcoming work related to operational plants, brownfield modifications, and revamp projects across multiple Energy assets. This role focuses on evaluating the structural condition of existing facilities, assessing degradation, verifying load capacity, and supporting engineering decisions related to life extension, structural tie-ins and structural reliability.
The Structural Integrity Engineer provides technical authority in structural assessment, load evaluation, and degradation‑related structural engineering, ensuring that all recommendations are technically defensible, compliant with international codes, and aligned with Client integrity requirements.
Responsabilities:

• Perform structural integrity assessments for non‑pressurized structural elements, including pipe racks, platforms, walkways, supports, buildings, foundations, and steel frames.

• Evaluate corrosion‑related section loss, deformation, vibration issues, and structural overstress conditions.

• Conduct load evaluations (dead, live, thermal, wind, seismic, equipment loads) for existing structures.

• Assess structural adequacy for revamp scopes, equipment replacement, and structural tie‑ins.

• Support API 579 Part 5/9 assessments only where applicable to structural components (e.g., local thin areas, crack‑like flaws).

• Review legacy structural drawings, as‑built documentation, and field measurements to validate structural capacity.

• Evaluate use of existing structures for new loads or modified operating conditions.

• Provide structural input to revamp engineering packages, MOCs, and tie‑in feasibility studies.

• - Support temporary works, lifting studies, and construction‑related structural checks.

• - Interpret inspection data and correlate degradation mechanisms with structural performance.

• - Prepare structural assessment reports, engineering justifications, and recommendations for repair, reinforcement, or replacement.

• - Interface with Mechanical, Corrosion, Process, and Inspection teams to resolve data gaps and ensure alignment.

• - Ensure compliance with Eurocodes, AISC, ASCE, API, and Client standards.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering. Master’s degree in Structural Engineering is an advantage.

• Minimum 5 years demonstrable experience acting as Structural Integrity Engineer.

• Experience with structural analysis software for assessment‑level calculations

• Chartered Engineer (CEng / PE / EUR Ing) or equivalent.

• API 579 familiarity (Parts 5 & 9) is an advantage.

• Training in structural assessment, Eurocodes, or API/ASME integrity standards.

• Strong understanding of structural analysis principles, load combinations, and code‑based assessment methods.

• Proficiency in evaluating non‑pressurized structural elements: steel structures, concrete structures, pipe racks, platforms, supports, and foundations.

• Ability to assess corrosion, section loss, deformation, vibration, and fatigue‑related issues.

• Familiarity with operational constraints, plant walkdowns, and brownfield engineering practices.

• Working knowledge of integrity management systems and inspection workflows.

Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

The Presales Digital Workplace & EUC Architect is a senior customer-facing role within the Atos UK&I Digital Workplace Practice. Working closely with Sales, Portfolio, Service Delivery, and Commercial teams, you will shape and design modern workplace solutions that enable productivity, collaboration, employee experience, and secure hybrid working.
You will lead the design of end-to-end Digital Workplace transformations spanning modern endpoint management, Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, workplace automation, employee experience, virtual desktop services, and managed workplace operations.
This role combines deep technical expertise with strong business understanding, enabling customers to modernise workplace services, improve user satisfaction, reduce operational costs, and accelerate adoption of AI-enabled ways of working.
Where purpose meets career:

• Continuous learning and exposure to innovative solutions: Work with a diverse portfolio of customers across multiple industries, tackling challenging data and AI initiatives, and applying your expertise across a variety of technologies, environments, and business contexts. This variety ensures continuous learning and exposure to innovative solutions.

• High-impact, market-facing role in Data, AI, and modern infrastructure, one of the fastest-growing areas in technology. You will influence strategic decisions, shape innovative solutions, and deliver measurable business outcomes, making a tangible difference for both clients and the organisation.

• Flexible, remote-first role with occasional travel, offering autonomy and the ability to manage your own schedule while staying connected with clients and cross-functional teams. Ideal for self-starters who thrive in an independent, high-responsibility environment.

Skills we can`t do without:

• Proven experience designing, developing, and consuming APIs across backend services and user-facing applications.

• Experience working with event-driven architectures and modern software development patterns.

• Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including testing, code quality, maintainability, and security.

• Experience working within Agile, self-organising teams and taking ownership of requirements from analysis through delivery.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable

• Experience working with AI, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or cloud-native applications.

• Exposure to a broad full-stack technology environment and the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

• Experience collaborating with Scrum Masters, Business Analysts, and Product Owners to refine requirements and deliver business value.

Benefits:

• Pension Scheme - contributions matched up to 10%

• Private medical cover

• Income Protection

• Life Assurance

• 25 days paid leave + National Holidays

• Flex benefits program

Note: This role is UK-based and offers a remote working opportunity, with occasional UK domestic travel as required

title: Dutch Sales Consultant (Part-time and remote)
description:
Want to work with an award-winning and quickly expanding company? We’re the leading website for outdoor holidays, making it a doddle to book camping, glamping and caravan sites all over the world, with over 5,300 to choose from.
Pitchup.com receives 33m annual visits and up to 7,500 bookings per day, with total transaction value 50% up compared to 2022 (a record-breaking year). So far £260m worth of holidays have been booked through us and we’ve helped 9m holidaymakers make their great escape. This year we launched our new mobile website, updating the look and feel and increasing conversion, with the desktop version soon to follow. The company is profitable and was founded in 2009 by former lastminute.com staff with a background in the holiday park sector.
You will join a nimble team of 70 based in 10 countries, all working from home, as we are a 100% remote business.
Our site has been featured in leading global media titles, such as BBC News, New York Times, Le Figaro, and more, and has been translated into 17 languages. We’re members of the Financial Times' FT1000 fastest growing companies in Europe and recently were awarded the Platinum Trusted Service Award by Feefo, for achieving a customer rating of at least 4.5 out of 5 for 3 years in a row.
We now have vacancies for exceptional Dutch-speaking sales professionals, to join our friendly, multinational team. As a member of our sales team, you'll work alongside our account coordinators to help our site owners set up their bookable listings, maintain their pricing and availability, and deal with any day-to-day queries.
The role
The main activity of the role will be to make sales calls from home to sign up campsites and holiday parks to taking bookings via our website. You will also help clients complete the registration process.

• Developing and maintaining a strong network of contacts and to support relationships with key supplier decision makers

• Discovering and following up for new accommodation

• Promoting product internally and providing recommendations on product as and when required

• Monitoring and analysing results, and ensuring client inventory is adequate and their allocation levels meet company requirements

Candidates will join a nimble team at a young company with extraordinary growth potential.
We are looking for candidates able to dedicate at least 15 hours per week. Hours for the role can vary from week to week and can be flexible to work around you and your family. Later, a permanent role may be offered to the right candidate. Some travel may be involved, but this is optional. This is a 100% remote role.
The candidate
Candidates should be self-starters, extremely flexible as far as tasks are concerned, and able to prioritise based on company needs while meeting tight deadlines. The successful candidate will fulfil the following additional criteria:

• Proven track record of conducting new business development including B2B cold calling

• Self-motivated to make 50 - 100 calls per shift, whilst following up emails and client communications

• Fluent in Dutch and English

• Organised and methodical approach

• A willingness to be a ‘jack-of-all-trades’ for the sake of being part of a forward-thinking start-up

• At least two years' experience in a related field

• Own a computer

• Internet savvy, with good technical skills

• Ability to troubleshoot independently

• A desire to take a big part in the establishment of Pitchup.com as a modern, creative brand

• General administrative skills, as well as experience within a customer-facing sector

• Excellent communication skills and phone manner

• Switched on

The package

• You will be paid a £12- £14 hourly rate (Euro 13-16 per hour) + a commission per campsite and uncapped 'superbonus'.

title: Network Systems Automation Engineer
description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Network Systems Automation Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$150,000 Annually

Key Responsibilities

• Hands-on experience with Ansible, Jinja2, Git, and CI/CD.

• Familiarity with NetBox, Nautobot, and modern network APIs.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

- Contribute to ad-hoc projects and analysis, alongside general administrative and filing support as required. (5%)

The Financial Operations team is a small, collaborative and trusted team with a broad range of responsibilities that impact the wider business. As part of the team, you will work on all products and collaborate across different departments, gaining invaluable experience with growth potential.

title: Financial Lines Claims Counsel

• Active bar admission in at least one U.S. jurisdiction and in good standing.

• 7+ years of experience handling Financial Lines claims, coverage litigation, or complex commercial litigation.

• Strong knowledge of D&O, Financial Institutions E&O, EPL, Fiduciary, and Fidelity coverages.

• Experience evaluating complex coverage issues and large-loss exposures.

• Background managing securities claims, class actions, regulatory matters, and high-exposure commercial disputes preferred.

• Experience working with primary policies preferred.

• Professional liability and financial institution claim expertise preferred.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to independently manage a sophisticated caseload and make sound claim decisions.

• Strong negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

title: Product Innovation Associate

- Own the technical evaluation. Lead full cycle product evaluations, design proofs of concept, and run pilots inside customer environments. Get developers actually using Factory and make sure they stick.

title: Design Lead
description:
Summit K12 is building a lean, modern design function - and you'll be at the center of it. As a Design Lead , you own the user experience for your product area and co-steward our shared design system, while staying hands-on in Figma every day. This is a player-coach role: you will design, lead our design efforts, and partner closely with Product Managers as a trusted consultant, helping bridge the gap between our design and product teams to ensure cohesive, high-quality outcomes.

We're a customer-driven, growing company - many of us came from the classrooms and districts we serve, so deep user knowledge lives in-house. We move fast: rather than lengthy research cycles, we validate with the educator expertise on our own team and quick feedback from real users. We're looking for someone who ships confidently without waiting for perfect data, uses AI tools to multiply their output, and earns influence through craft and judgment rather than title or process.
Key Responsibilities

Steward the Design System

• Maintain and evolve the Summit K12 design system - components, patterns, typography, color, accessibility standards, and interaction behaviors

• Keep the system documented, versioned, and genuinely used, so teams move faster with it than without it

• Partner with Engineering to ensure components are technically feasible and consistently implemented

• Drive adoption - you and your fellow Design Leads share accountability for the system actually being used across teams, reducing UX fragmentation through enablement and reusable patterns rather than policing

• Decide, jointly with your fellow Design Leads, what enters the system and when projects in your area can deviate from it, escalating consequential additions, cross-product deviations, and any calls the leads can't align on.

Consult with Product

• Act as a design consultant and force multiplier to Product Managers - in a world where a PM can spin up an AI prototype in an afternoon, you're the one who makes it shippable: coherent, accessible, and on-system

• Engage early in discovery to shape solutions, not just review them at the end

• Make the case for design through outcomes - demonstrate how strong UX reduces rework, support burden, and churn

• Be the Design Lead your teams trust for day-to-day design calls

Design, Hands-On

• Spend real time in Figma - this is a shipping role, not a pure oversight role

• Translate platform experience strategy into concrete, consistent navigation, workflows, and interaction patterns across all user types

• Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, v0, Figma AI) to accelerate design and development workflows

• Integrate Universal Design for Learning (UDL) principles into the design system so interaction patterns work for the full range of learner abilities

Validate Lean

• Use lightweight validation - heuristic reviews, quick user feedback loops, analytics, and support signals - in place of heavyweight research studies

• Know when a decision needs evidence and when experienced judgment is enough

• Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and simplicity in every experience

Set The Standard

• Set clear expectations for quality, ownership, and accountability

• Run lean design workflows in Figma and Jira that support fast iteration and predictable delivery

• Foster a culture of user empathy, experimentation, and low-ego collaboration

• Lead, mentor and develop the designers you work with

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required

• 6+ years in product/UX design, including owning a design system

• Experience leading or mentoring designers while staying hands-on

• Fluency in Figma and comfort managing design work in Jira

• Active use of AI tools in your design workflow, and enthusiasm for operating as an AI-leveraged, lean design function

• Strong grounding in user-centered design, interaction design, and Universal Design for Learning

• Experience with WCAG accessibility standards, including interpreting ACRs and driving remediatio

title: Sr. Software Engineer - Go/MongoDB
description:
MongoDB Tools Team
Team: MongoDB Tools (Product and Engineering)
Location: Remote
Projects: percona/percona-clustersync-mongodb and percona/percona-backup-mongodb
About the team
The MongoDB Tools Team builds Percona 's open source operational tooling for MongoDB. Two projects sit at the center of what we do. Percona ClusterSync for MongoDB (PCSM) clones and continuously replicates data between clusters. Percona Backup for MongoDB (PBM) is a distributed, low-impact backup and restore solution for replica sets and sharded clusters. Both are written in Go, both are Apache 2.0 licensed, and both are built fully in the open.
This role sits primarily on PCSM, which is younger and moving fast, so you will have real influence over how it takes shape. You will also work across into PBM. The two tools share many hard problems: cluster topology, the oplog and change streams, consistency across shards, and performance in very large production clusters. Backup and restore experience is a real advantage here, not just a box to tick.
The projects

• PCSM (primary focus): initial data cloning followed by continuous change replication over MongoDB Change Streams, for both replica sets and sharded clusters. Still pre-1.0 and evolving quickly.

• PBM (secondary): consistent backup and restore with point-in-time recovery, using oplog capture to stay consistent across replica sets and sharded clusters, with S3-compatible and filesystem storage. Driven by pbm-agent processes on each node and a pbm CLI. Mature and widely deployed in production.

What you will work on
Primary, on PCSM

• The core replication engine: initial collection cloning followed by continuous change capture over MongoDB Change Streams, with correct handling of resume tokens, ordering, and resumability after failures.

• Correctness and fault tolerance at scale: recovering cleanly from network drops, primary elections, and restarts without losing or duplicating changes, and reasoning carefully about the delivery guarantees we can honestly promise.

• Sharded cluster support: replicating across shards, dealing with the realities of chunk migrations and balancer activity, and keeping the target consistent.

• Namespace filtering and automatic index management, plus the edge cases that show up with DDL, TTL, and index differences between source and target.

• Performance and throughput: parallelizing the clone, applying backpressure, and keeping memory and connection use sane against large clusters with great change volume.

• The CLI and HTTP API that drive and observe a sync, and the metrics and logging that let an operator trust what is happening.

Also across PBM

• Consistent backup, restore, and point-in-time recovery across replica sets and sharded clusters, using physical or logical type of the backup.

• Backup storage: integrating reliably with main cloud object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob Storage...) and remote filesystems, and handling the throughput and failure modes that show up at scale.

• The pbm-agent and pbm CLI, and the control-collection state in MongoDB that coordinates them across the cluster.

Shared across both

• Working in the open: pull requests, code review, JIRA, and the community forum.

• Release quality: tests, packaging, and the CI and security scanning that gate every change.

What Have You Done:

• Strong Go experience in production, with real fluency in concurrency: goroutines, channels, context cancellation, worker pools, and backpressure. You have debugged a race condition that only showed up under load, and you know how you found it.

• Solid grounding in distributed systems and data consistency. You can talk clearly about at-least-once versus exactly-once, idempotency, ordering, and what it takes to make a stateful process resumable.

• Hands-on MongoDB knowledge: change streams, the oplog, resume tokens, replica sets, and sharding. You do not need to have built replication before, but you should understand why it is hard.

• Comfort buildi

title: Creative Command Center Lead
description:
About NewWorld

NewWorld is a media company that restores our ability to imagine a world better than the one we inherited. We build the stories, worlds, and communities where that future stops feeling radical and starts feeling popular, possible, and ours to demand and get.

We do this three ways: original shows we own, strategy and Command Center services we deliver for clients, and shows with charitable purpose commissioned through our Media Fund. One studio, one method, one point of view.

What a Creative Command Center does

A Command Center is a small, senior, always-on team that connects four things normally kept apart: research (rigorous information on audiences and what/who they tune into), creators (the people our audiences usually trust more than other institutions), production (content shipped at the speed of the platforms), and amplification (taking the best and most responsive content and moving it creatively through the algorithm).

A Command Center works in two stages. The first is activation, which means identifying the voices a particular audience already trusts and briefing them well enough that they will speak in their own words about something they had not previously been talking about. Those voices are rarely the client's own channels and never paid spokespeople reading from a script. We are connecting to the credibility of creators, commentators, community figures and coalition partners who have standing we cannot manufacture ourselves.

The second stage is amplification, and it is where most creator programs fail. A creator post that reaches only its own following remains a piece of content, while the same post picked up by amplifier accounts, placed behind paid social and digital, pitched into earned media, extended into out-of-home or a live event, and coordinated with distribution partners becomes the conversation itself. Making that happen requires directing a bench of specialist vendors so that their work compounds rather than running in parallel lanes, which is a large part of this job.

The Command Center operates in both directions. Reactive work means breaking a false or predatory story before its frame hardens, on a timeline measured in hours rather than weeks. Proactive work means setting the terms of a conversation before anyone else has the chance to.

Earlier this year we built a Command Center for a candidate facing roughly $10 million in attack spending from pro-AI-industry groups, beginning from almost no name recognition. The work generated 22 million views in a district of 750,000 voters and more than a million engagements, outperforming the industry engagement benchmark by a factor of three and paid engagement by nearly twelve. He finished within four points of winning, and the attack that was meant to end his candidacy became the thing his campaign was best known for.

The role

You will run 1-2 Creative Command Centers. The work involves turning a narrative strategy into an operation that ships on a reliable cadence: setting the operating rhythm and the approval paths, writing and commissioning the briefs, building and managing the roster of trusted voices, and directing the vendors who amplify them so that paid media, creator management, earned media and production are all working from one calendar and one set of metrics. You will also be the senior NewWorld person in the room with the client, which means you are trusted to make decisions without checking first.

The Command Centers coming online over the next year sit in different worlds, including financial confidence, product launches, worker power, gender and identity, product marketing, climate resilience and electoral politics, and we are not looking for a subject-matter expert in any one of them. What we need is someone who has moved between worlds over the course of their own career and can become fluent in a new one quickly, because that adaptation is the job rather than a prelude to it.

Who we are looking for

title: Associate Materials Engineer
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

Materials Engineer will perform material selection, qualification, testing and analysis of composite materials used in satellite structures, supporting material and design qualification for space applications. This role executes thermal, mechanical, and microstructural testing, interprets and cross-correlates results to assess material integrity, and documents findings that support qualification of flight hardware materials.

Key Responsibilities:

• Plan and execute mechanical, thermal, and microstructural testing of composite materials and structural components specific to satellite hardware.

• Operate and interpret data from DSC (Differential Scanning Calorimetry), DMA (Dynamic Mechanical Analysis), UTM (Universal Testing Machine), surface energy analyzer, optical microscopy, profilometry and other composite and polymer testing.

• Cross-correlate results across test methods to assess material integrity, performance, and failure behavior.

• Perform statistical analysis of test data, including B-basis allowable development, and apply design of experiments to test planning.

• Support material and design qualification campaigns for space applications, from coupon-level testing through structural component validation.

• Design and oversee qualification procedures for composite materials and structures, including test plans, acceptance criteria, and execution against space program requirements.

• Document findings in test reports, data packages, and qualification records that support material qualification and program milestones.

• Partner with Design, Structures, Manufacturing, and Quality teams to translate test results into material selection and design decisions.

Qualifications

 Education:

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related discipline.

Experience:

• 0-3 years in materials testing, composites, or structural test engineering within aerospace or manufacturing environments.

• Hands-on composite lab and testing experience, including specimen preparation, fixturing, and test execution.

• Experience with space materials, ideally in aerospace or space structural applications.

• Working knowledge of thermal, mechanical, and microstructural characterization methods and data interpretation

• Proficiency with CAD software (Autodesk Inventor, AutoCAD, and SolidWorks) for reviewing designs and developing test fixtures.

• Strong understanding of the mechanics of composite materials, including failure criteria.

Preferred Qualifications: 

• Experience with DSC, DMA, UTM, optical microscopy, and profilometry, and with composite testing generally.

• Statistical analysis for B-basis allowable and design of experiments (DOE).

• Familiarity with composite test standards and material qualification programs.

• Exposure to aerospace hardware development, testing, or manufacturing

• Strong presentation and communication skills

• Ability to manage complex, cross-functional environments

• Ability to work across multiple time zones with schedule flexibility

• Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Continuous Improvement Mindset

• Technical Communication

Technology Stack:

• Proficiency in composite material testing and standards.

• CAD software: Autodesk Inventor, AutoCAD, and SolidWorks.

 Physical Requirements

• Availability to travel domestically and internationally

title: GTM Technology Engineer
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The GTM Technology team sits within GTM Operations and owns the systems, architecture, and automation that power Plaid's go-to-market motion - Salesforce administration and platform architecture, quote-to-cash, lead-to-cash data integrity, and the evaluation and rollout of new GTM tooling, including AI and agentic tooling. We partner closely with Sales, Finance, and Engineering to make sure the systems behind revenue are accurate, scalable, and increasingly automated.

We're hiring a GTM Technology Engineer to help build and maintain the technical backbone of our GTM systems. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can write production-quality Salesforce code (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL), design clean integrations across our GTM stack (Salesforce, CPQ, contract lifecycle management, sales engagement, data warehouse, and more), and bring an AI-forward, builder mentality to how we automate and scale GTM Operations workflows.

You'll work on everything from diagnosing and fixing Apex logic that drives revenue-critical fields, to building integrations that connect Salesforce with adjacent platforms, to designing and deploying AI-powered agents and automations (using LLM APIs, MCP servers, and agentic workflows) that remove manual work from the GTM org. You'll report into GTM Technology and work alongside Salesforce architects, GTM Operations partners, and Engineering.

Responsibilities

- Salesforce development: Design, build, and maintain Apex classes, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Flows that support core GTM processes.

- Data integrity & diagnostics: Investigate and resolve issues in revenue-critical Apex services, tracing root causes across triggers, flows, and integration touchpoints.

• DevOps: Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions ou Azure DevOps), conteinerização (Docker) e implantação de serviços Python em ambientes de nuvem, incluindo Azure App Service ou Azure Functions.

• Segurança: Conhecimento prático de autenticação baseada em OAuth 2.0 / JWT, Azure Active Directory (Entra ID), controle de acesso baseado em funções (RBAC) e proteção de APIs em ambientes corporativos regulamentados.

title: Design Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a design engineer to help build and maintain Waypoint, our design system, across both the Figma library and the production codebase. This is not a "designer who codes a little" or an "engineer who dabbles in Figma" role. You should be genuinely fluent on both sides, comfortable defining a component's behavior and states in Figma one hour and shipping the same component to npm the next.

You'll take direct ownership of the Figma side of our library (structure, variants, tokens, documentation) while also contributing to the core Waypoint system: our component packages, our token pipeline, and the tooling that keeps design and code in sync. If the idea of being the single point of continuity between a Figma frame and a production component sounds exciting rather than exhausting, this is your role.

We're also thinking beyond the system we have today. Waypoint isn't just meant to serve designers and engineers, it's meant to become something a model can read, reason about, and build with directly. We want someone who can help us get there: grounded enough to do the unglamorous work of making today's system solid, and forward looking enough to help define what an intelligent design system looks like next.

WHY THIS ROLE

Waypoint is still early enough that the decisions you make now will shape how the system scales. You'll have real ownership, not just a queue of component tickets, and you'll be working alongside a team that treats design and engineering as one discipline rather than two departments that hand work back and forth. And you'll be helping define what a design system becomes when it has to serve a third audience: the models that will increasingly build with it.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: component structure, variants, properties, and documentation, so it stays a reliable source of truth for design teams.

- Build and maintain core Waypoint components, contributing directly to our component packages alongside the design engineering team.

- Work across our token pipeline, keeping design tokens in Figma and their code representations (CSS custom properties, Tailwind config) tightly synced.

- Partner with product designers to translate new patterns into system components, and with product engineers to make sure those components are easy to adopt correctly.

- Help define and refine the workflows and tooling that connect Figma and code (sync scripts, plugins, documentation sites) rather than relying on manual handoff.

- Write clear documentation and usage guidance so the system scales without you being the bottleneck.

- Weigh in on system architecture decisions: when to add a new component versus extend an existing one, how to version and package changes, how to keep the system consistent as it grows.

- Help shape how Waypoint evolves to serve a third consumer beyond designers and engineers: the model itself. That means thinking about how components, tokens, and patterns get structured so they're legible to AI systems, not just to humans.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: c

description:
ASRC Federal is a leading government contractor furthering missions in space, public health and defense. ASRC Federal is seeking a ITSM Team Lead to support the DoS STS program Position Summary The ITSM Team Lead, ServiceNow leads day-to-day functional support and continuous improvement of ServiceNow capabilities supporting enterprise IT operations. The role coordinates stakeholder requirements, enhancements, testing, reporting, user support, and process improvement while providing direction to the ITSM team and serving as a liaison between stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership. Key Responsibilities

• Lead intake, analysis, prioritization, and tracking of ServiceNow requirements and enhancement requests.

• Translate business and operational needs into functional requirements, user stories, test scenarios, and implementation actions.

• Coordinate enhancements through requirements validation, UAT, defect resolution, production release, and stakeholder communication.

• Provide functional leadership for ServiceNow ITSM processes, reporting, dashboards, CMDB-related activities, and supported scoped applications.

• Oversee troubleshooting, user support, training, and coordination of issue resolution with technical teams.

• Develop operational, queue-management, executive, and performance reporting using ServiceNow reporting and Platform Analytics.

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, automate manual activities, strengthen data quality, and standardize ITSM processes.

• Provide day-to-day direction, mentoring, workload coordination, and quality oversight for ITSM team members while communicating priorities, risks, and status to leadership.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• 5+ years of progressive experience in IT service management, ServiceNow, business analysis, reporting, or related enterprise IT operations.

• Experience gathering requirements, coordinating ServiceNow enhancements, leading UAT, and supporting production releases.

• Strong functional knowledge of core ITSM processes, including Incident, Request, Change, and Configuration Management.

• Experience developing dashboards, operational metrics, and management reporting in ServiceNow or comparable platforms.

• Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• ServiceNow, ITIL, and/or PMP certification.

• Experience supporting a federal government or other large, regulated enterprise environment.

• Experience with ServiceNow Platform Analytics, CMDB, Discovery, scoped applications, or workflow automation.

• Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.
